wiki.title: Cassie Chambers Armstrong
wiki.extract: Cassie Chambers Armstrong (born September 30, 1986) is an American politician who is a member of the Democratic Party representing District 19 in the Kentucky Senate since March 2, 2023. A former member of the Louisville Metro Council, she served from January 1, 2021, until she won a special election on February 21, 2023, to fill the state Senate vacancy left by U.S. Representative Morgan McGarvey. Outside of her legislative service, she is an assistant professor of law at the University of Louisville Brandeis School of Law.
